medicines.name: Bundled illustrative sample catalogue
medicines.description: A small demonstration catalogue using well-known active ingredients and strengths. It exists to test search, matching and price-comparison flows. It is NOT an official PMBJP product list.
medicines.price_policy: All prices are illustrative sample values. None is an official Jan Aushadhi MRP. Every row sets jan_price_verified=0 and is_sample=1.
medicines.product_identifiers: SAMPLE-001 to SAMPLE-054 are internal demonstration codes, not official product identifiers.
medicines.refresh: Replace data/medicines.csv using scripts/import_catalogue.py with a documented source, retrieval date and permitted-use review. Then rebuild the database.

kendras.name: Bundled illustrative sample Kendra records
kendras.description: Fifteen records named explicitly as sample records. Names, addresses and telephone numbers are not real. Coordinates are city-centre points used only to demonstrate distance sorting.
kendras.notice: Do not present these records as real Kendras. Use https://janaushadhi.gov.in/locate-kendra to find an actual Kendra.
kendras.refresh: Replace data/kendras.csv using scripts/import_catalogue.py only with an official, permitted dataset that includes source and retrieval metadata.
